tagline: Qwen3.8, Qwen3.6, and DeepSeek on your own GPU
description:
Strata runs high-end mixture-of-experts models on a single consumer GPU.
The default is Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (22.9 GB download, 32 GB RAM, about
60 tokens/s on an RTX 3060). Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and DeepSeek V4.1-Flash
are selectable with FAMILY and MODEL.

It exposes an OpenAI-compatible `/v1` API and an Anthropic-compatible
`/v1/messages` API, so OpenCode, Claude Code, curl, and other clients can
use it. The web UI is on port 8088. Every API request needs the key.

This store entry ships the official `ghcr.io/niko1221/strata:0.2.9-cuda13`
image for NVIDIA RTX 20/30/40/50 cards with driver 580 or newer.

Need Qwen3.8-Flash-Next? Set `FAMILY=qwen` and `MODEL=Q2_0`: 66-76 GB
download, 48 GB+ RAM. DeepSeek V4.1-Flash: `FAMILY=deepseek41` and
`MODEL=ist-das-2.00bpw`: 257 GB download, 46-64 GB RAM.

AMD RX 7000/9000, Strix Halo, Intel Arc, and NVIDIA GTX 10/Pascal need
a different image tag (see the docs). There is no CPU-only or Vulkan path.

CasaOS/ZimaOS packaging by Carpathians. Strata is developed by Niko1221.
author: Niko1221

tips.before_install:
NVIDIA RTX 20/30/40/50 with driver 580+ and the NVIDIA Container
Toolkit. 12 GB+ VRAM and 32 GB+ RAM for the default Qwen3.6 model;
48 GB+ RAM for Qwen3.8 Q2_0; 46-64 GB RAM for DeepSeek.

Allow 40 GB+ free in /DATA/AppData for Qwen3.6, 100 GB+ for Qwen3.8,
and 300 GB+ for DeepSeek. The first start downloads the model (tens of
GB) and shows "starting" in the app while it does.

GTX 10/Pascal, AMD, and Intel Arc need a different image tag; this
entry ships cuda13 for RTX 20-50. There is no CPU-only path.
tips.after_install:
Open http://YOUR_HOST_IP:8088 for the UI. The OpenAI-compatible base
URL is http://YOUR_HOST_IP:8088/v1 (model name from GET /v1/models);
the Anthropic-compatible base URL is http://YOUR_HOST_IP:8088.

The API key is generated on first start. Show it with:

docker exec strata strata launch --show-key --preset docker

Or set API_KEY to your own 16+ character key before installing.

title: Strata
release_note:
0.2.9 - official CUDA 13 image for NVIDIA RTX 20/30/40/50.

Default model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-Q4_K_XL (22.9 GB, 32 GB RAM).
Set FAMILY/MODEL for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next or DeepSeek V4.1-Flash.

First start downloads the model; watch the app logs. The API key is
generated on first start unless you set API_KEY.
